change: Server structure staging replaces complete cells in its private copy-on-write geometry snapshot instead of replaying leaves. History replay, save-before-publication order, admission caps and formats remain unchanged. Replacement copies the tree wrapper before freezing; persistent nodes are shared. Ordinary apply now routes through replacement and adds a wrapper copy; no universal ordinary-edit speedup is claimed.

tests.initial_attempt: One new test fixture errored because SparseVoxelOctree.set rejects LED alpha 254. Changed fixture to fill, which handles world materials. Repeated selected suites passed. No runtime validation was relaxed.
tests.focused_rerun: Repeated WorldVoxelSnapshotTest after adding an explicit 0xfe123456 sentinel to strengthen aliasing/air-replacement assertions: four tests passed, zero failures/errors/skips. Production source unchanged.

probe.scope: Geometry-only CPU staging of 64 cells with 512 fractional leaves each. Three warmups and 20 samples per path; input construction, history, save, transfer, rendering and package admission excluded. Thread allocated bytes are not peak memory. Negative coordinates and unchanged snapshot/unrelated cell verified every sample. This is not a city/max benchmark. Both measured paths use the current apply/replace API in one JVM; this is not a timed parent-revision comparison.
